title: A Targaryen queen at Winterfell
description: Daenerys rides through Winterfell's gates beside Jon with Unsullied, Dothraki and two dragons — to a North that greets her in cold silence. Jon learns he has a dragon's saddle waiting.

title: The Night King's message
description: Tormund and Beric find Last Hearth silent — and little Ned Umber pinned to the wall in a spiral of severed limbs that opens its eyes and screams.

title: Sam tells Jon who he is
description: In the crypts beneath Winterfell, Samwell tells Jon the truth of his birth: he is Aegon Targaryen, son of Rhaegar and Lyanna — king by right, and his queen's nephew.

title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
description: On the last night before the dead arrive, Jaime Lannister draws his sword by the fire and knights Brienne of Tarth — the first woman knight in Westerosi memory.
episodeTitle: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms

title: The Long Night
description: The living make their stand at Winterfell against the whole army of the dead. The Dothraki charge dies in the dark; the crypts betray their shelterers; Melisandre lights the trenches; the castle drowns in wights.

title: Not today
description: As the Night King reaches for Bran beneath the heart tree, Arya Stark comes out of the dark. The dagger drops from one hand to the other — and the Night King and every walker and wight shatter like ice.

title: The price of the dawn
description: Theon dies charging the Night King, redeemed in Bran's godswood. Jorah falls shielding Daenerys; Lyanna Mormont kills a giant with her last breath; Edd, Beric and Melisandre — her purpose done, walking into the sunrise to die — join them.

title: Euron kills Rhaegal
description: Sailing home from victory, the fleet rounds Dragonstone into Euron's ambush. Scorpion bolts take Rhaegal through the neck, and Missandei is dragged from the waves in chains.

title: Dracarys
description: Before the walls of King's Landing, Cersei gives Missandei of Naath one last word. She chooses 'dracarys' — and the Mountain's blade falls as Daenerys and Grey Worm watch.

title: The Spider's last letters
description: Varys backs the better claim one whisper too far. On the beach of Dragonstone, Daenerys speaks the sentence and Drogon carries it out — as Tyrion, who informed on him, watches his friend burn.

title: The bells ring — and she burns it all
description: King's Landing surrenders; the bells ring out. Daenerys, on Drogon's back above the gates, hears them — and turns the city to ash street by street, soldiers and children alike, until nothing of the capital stands.

title: Cleganebowl
description: On a ruined stair beneath the falling Red Keep, Sandor Clegane meets his brother at last. Steel cannot kill what Qyburn made — so the Hound drags the Mountain with him into the fire below.

title: The lions die together
description: Jaime cuts down Euron on the beach and reaches Cersei in the collapsing crypts of the Red Keep. No boat, no way out — the twins who began the story die in each other's arms as the ceiling comes down.

title: The Iron Throne
description: In the ashen throne room, Daenerys speaks of breaking the wheel across the world. Jon kisses her — and drives a dagger into her heart. Drogon melts the Iron Throne to slag and carries her body east.

title: The council of Bran the Broken
description: In the Dragonpit, Tyrion talks the lords of Westeros into a new order: Bran the Broken, king by story rather than birth, with Tyrion as his Hand and the wheel — at least the old one — broken.

title: The Queen in the North
description: Sansa alone refuses to bend: the North leaves the Six Kingdoms as it entered — free. She is crowned Queen in the North in Winterfell's great hall.

title: The wolves scatter
description: Arya sails west of the maps; Brienne finishes Jaime's page in the White Book; and Jon Snow rides out from Castle Black with Ghost and the free folk, north into the green — where the story leaves him.
